title: Add one item (cart size 0 -> 1)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack (EP: any product is one class; Sauce Labs Bike Light = untouched control)
steps: Check badge is empty ; Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack
expected_result: Badge 0 to 1; Backpack button changes to Remove; Bike Light button stays Add to cart

title: Add a second item (cart size 1 -> 2)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
steps: Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack ; Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Bike Light
expected_result: Badge 1 after first item, 2 after second; both buttons show Remove

title: Add every product (cart size 5 -> 6, upper boundary)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
steps: Click Add to cart on each product in turn, top to bottom
expected_result: Badge increments by 1 after each click (1..6); each clicked button changes to Remove

title: Cart shows the same names and prices as Products (2 items)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
steps: Note name and price of both items on Products ; Click Add to cart on both ; Open the cart
expected_result: Your Cart opens and lists exactly the 2 items with the same names and prices as on Products

title: Cart shows the same names and prices as Products (all 6 items, upper boundary)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
steps: Note name and price of every product on Products ; Click Add to cart on each ; Open the cart
expected_result: Your Cart opens and lists exactly 6 items with the same names and prices as on Products
